name: vkp-model-connector
description: Consent-gated connector for VKP text, vision, and ASR model APIs

interface.shortDescription: Run approved text, vision, and ASR model tasks.
interface.longDescription: Exposes a narrow VKP MCP service that can inspect and execute human-created, hash-locked online-model consents. It never stores API keys and cannot create or confirm consent.
defaultPrompt: Check a VKP model consent without sending data.
Run the approved VKP model task and report its artifact.
